title: Check Whether Three Sides Form a Triangle
question: Read three side lengths and check whether they can form a triangle.
code:
a = float(input("Side A: "))
b = float(input("Side B: "))
c = float(input("Side C: "))
if a > 0 and b > 0 and c > 0 and a + b > c and a + c > b and b + c > a:
    print("Valid triangle")
else:
    print("Invalid triangle")
expected_output:
For inputs 3, 4, and 5:
Side A: 3
Side B: 4
Side C: 5
Valid triangle
explanation: All sides must be positive, and the sum of any two sides must be greater than the third.
